scenes.say: Imagine telling your computer: plan my trip to Tokyo. And instead of just answering, it actually does it.
scenes.title: It doesn't just answer. It *does it*.
scenes.subtitle: How AI agents work, in 60 seconds

scenes.say: That is the difference between a chatbot and an AI agent. A chatbot talks. An agent takes action, step by step, until the job is done.
scenes.heading: Chatbot vs agent

scenes.say: Every agent runs the same simple loop. It looks at the goal, makes a plan, takes an action, and then checks the result.
scenes.heading: The agent loop

scenes.say: The actions come from tools. A web search, a calendar, a code runner, even your email. The agent picks the right tool for each step.
scenes.heading: Actions come from *tools*

scenes.say: So for your trip, it searches for flights, compares the prices, books the best one, and adds it to your calendar.
scenes.heading: Your Tokyo trip

scenes.say: And if something goes wrong, like a sold out flight, it notices, rethinks, and tries again. That loop is what makes it an agent.
scenes.text: The *loop* is what makes it an agent

scenes.say: Good agents also know when to stop and ask you, especially before they spend your money or send a message.
So an AI agent is a model, plus tools, plus a loop. Follow for more simple AI explainers.
scenes.title: Model + tools + *loop*
